key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped, flooding the shoreline and city streets.
Damage reported to shoreline homes, public docks and cottages.
Water intake pumps were impacted by the rapid change in water level.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m were recorded at the Ludington harbor gauge.
Water level fluctuations of about 2 m were reported along the coastline just outside the harbor.
missing_information: No quantified counts of damaged structures provided.
Impacts outside Ludington not detailed with specific place names.
